title: The Southward Offensive
subtitle: The German operational turn south and Soviet defences around Kiev
author: R.G. Cruise
phase: III — The Battle for Strategic Objectives
summary: German redirection toward Ukraine and the Southwestern Front as the Desna and Dnieper sectors became central to strategy.
outlineTopics: The military situation inherited from August 25.
Hitler's August 21 decision concerning German strategic priorities.
The competing demands of Moscow, Leningrad, and Ukraine.

Heinz Guderian's 2nd Panzer Group and its assigned objectives.
Army Group South under Gerd von Rundstedt.
Ewald von Kleist's 1st Panzer Group and its northern operational objectives.
Soviet defensive dispositions around Kiev and the Dnieper.
The importance of the Desna, Seym, and Dnieper river systems.
Soviet command decisions concerning the defense of Ukraine.
German logistical and operational difficulties as formations changed direction.
Simultaneous fighting toward Leningrad and around Smolensk.
